method: For each representative point-passing moving bbox sample from the50 largest distinct reported road/lane pairs, independently project outside centroid on reported source road. Build original non-driving lane polygons with exact XML widths, independent road curve at0.1m s steps within6m of projected centroid; measure outside polygon intersection area. Source type area is XY corroboration on reported road only, not exclusive classification among overlapping junction roads; source sidewalk heights are not separately evaluated here. Driving union height filtering is in map/audit/vehicle_footprint_audit.json.
